data.body:
Gerrit change 2649 status at hand-off: `NEW`, not WIP, no votes yet — `LLM-Review []`, `Verified []`, `Code-Review []`, one message ("Uploaded patch set 1"). Both bots are backlogged rather than failing: `gh run list --workflow=gerrit-verify.yaml` shows three Gerrit Verified Gate runs still `queued` and two `in_progress`, the oldest queued for 40+ minutes, against a normal run time of ~23 minutes. Nothing to act on; the gates simply have not reached this change yet.

Ticket left `in_progress` and the change left unsubmitted, as instructed. Local checks are all green (see the previous comment), so a `Verified -1` here would be new information rather than an expected outcome.
